notes.title: Matrix Games is the new Home of Combat Mission
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to announce the [b]acquisition of Battlefront[/b], the renowned developers behind the Combat Mission series. 

[h2]ELEVATING COMBAT MISSION'S LEGACY[/h2]
This strategic move underscores our commitment to the wargaming community and the legacy of Combat Mission—a franchise celebrated for its unmatched tactical and strategic depth. With [b]over 1 million copies sold worldwide[/b], Combat Mission remains a defining force in the genre, setting the standard for authentic warfare simulations.

[previewyoutube=u3OwoL7A4RE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]LOOKING FORWARD[/h2]
This acquisition marks a new chapter for Combat Mission, as we plan to enhance the series with cutting-edge technology and innovative gameplay, all while preserving the core elements that have made it a favorite among wargamers for [b]over 25 years[/b].

[b]Battlefront's entire team[/b], including the original creators, [b]will be joining Slitherine[/b], ensuring the continuity and quality that fans have come to expect.

This partnership makes a milestone in wargaming, with Slitherine and Battlefront committed to delivering the best possible experience and ensuring the continued growth and success of the Combat Mission franchise.

[h2]AVAILABILITY & DISTRIBUTION[/h2]
Combat Mission titles [b]will continue to be available[/b] on all current platforms, including Matrix Games and Steam. To help both new and existing players, we have updated our [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/battlefront-acquisition-faq]FAQ[/url] and "[url=https://www.matrixgames.com/combat-mission-how-to-download-my-games]How to Download My Games[/url]" sections, making it easier than ever to access and enjoy the series.

[h2]A DAY OF CELEBRATION[/h2]
To celebrate this exciting milestone, we're thrilled to offer [b]discounts of up to 60%[/b] on all Combat Mission titles. This is a [b]limited-time sale[/b], available until September 3rd, so don't miss out: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/combatmissionfranchisesale


Additionally, we have organized a full day of streaming on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv/schedule]Twitch channel[/url]. The schedule includes a variety of Combat Mission titles, showcasing gameplay and strategies. Join us to experience our streamers in action and engage with our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772341/81576c3109a93360acd451e5856c3d135c4091e5.jpg[/img]

We are also pleased to announce the opening of subscriptions for a new Battle for Normandy [url=https://www.slitherine.com/tournaments]tournament[/url] featuring [b]three brand new maps[/b]. These maps have been meticulously crafted, all starting from the master map of the Battle Pack 2.

Enjoy this Combat Mission milestone and celebration and [b]don’t miss[/b] this perfect opportunity to expand your collection and dive into the acclaimed tactical warfare series at an unbeatable price.

notes.title: "Choose Your Own Scenario" community activity on Discord
notes.content:
Today marks the beginning of an exciting new chapter for our community as we launch our very first [b]community activity[/b] on Discord. Starting today, every three days we will conduct a [b]poll[/b] featuring various questions that will shape the design and creation of the next three [b]fictional multiplayer maps[/b] for Combat Mission.

These new maps will be brought to life by the talented Usually Hapless, who will use the community's responses from the polls to guide his creative process. But that's not all – Usually Hapless will also create a video tutorial, providing an in-depth look at how he crafts these maps using the game's editor.

Once the maps are completed, we are thrilled to announce that there will be a [b]special tournament[/b] featuring these community-inspired maps. This tournament will give players a chance to showcase their skills on the new battlegrounds and compete for a [b]prize pool[/b] filled with coupon rewards.

[b]Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/8hBhcYrErE]Discord[/url][/b] today and help shape the future of Combat Mission maps. Your input is crucial, and we can't wait to see the incredible maps and intense battles that will come from this collaborative effort.

notes.title: Combat Mission Black Sea - Update v02.18.00
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the release of pbem+++ and tournament support for Combat Mission: Black Sea.

You will soon be able to participate in official tournaments and play multiplayer matches to test your skills against other players.

Here is the changelog:

NEW
• ADDED: Matrix/Slitherine PBEM++ and Tournament feature
BUG FIXES
• Corrected a problem with T-90 frontal armor
• FIXED: Multi-team HQ units block out UI information at end-of-game
• FIXED: AI gets confused with two targets and enters a cycle of turning the turret back and forth 
and never choosing a target

We are excited to offer these new features to the dedicated community of Combat Mission players. Thanks for your patience and have fun.

notes.title: Combat Mission Black Sea - Out Now
notes.content:

Combat Mission Black Sea, one of the most popular titles in the renowned Combat Mission franchise, is now available on the Matrix Store and on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502380/Combat_Mission_Black_Sea/][b]Steam[/b][/url]. 

Get ready to command detailed, highly researched American, Ukrainian and Russian units and immerse yourself in an hypothetical open conflict in the summer of 2017.

Four high-risk campaigns, 22 self-contained scenarios and a plethora of Quick Battle maps await you and will test your tactical acumen. 

Extend your gaming experience with the "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502390/Combat_Mission_Black_Sea__Battle_Pack_1/][b]Battle Pack 1[/b][/url]" DLC already available for purchase. 

Fight alongside Americans and Ukranian forces to stop the Russian advance on Kiev, or command a Battle Tactical Group from the Russian 205th Motorized Rifle Brigade and bring the fight to Ukrainian and American forces! 


[b]Anyone with a copy of the game purchased on Battlefront.com will also be able to redeem a Steam key [url=https://www.slitherine.com/member/registerserial]HERE[/url] using their original game code.[/b]

notes.title: Combat Mission: Black Sea hits home the realities of fighting a peer enemy
notes.content:
Another of Battlefront's popular WEGO military sim/wargames, Combat Mission: Black Sea (CMBS) is being released on Steam today. It's the second of the company's stable to make this leap, following Combat Mission: Shock Force 2 (CMSF2) which was released late last year thanks to a new publishing partnership with with Matrix Games/Slitherine.

CMBS was first launched in 2014 and covers a fictional war in Ukraine between NATO, Russian and Ukrainian forces. Like CMSF (which takes place in Syria) it was developed before the real conflicts in the Ukraine and Syria took place and doesn't represent the real war. These suspiciously prophetic coincidences do suggest, however, that if Battlefront ever does a game about a zombie apocalypse then it's probably time to run for the hills.

The backstory to the game was altered to fit with recent events and sees the Crimea splitting from Ukraine, the Ukrainians joining NATO, Russia forcefully objecting and all hell breaking loose. The plot is very well developed and frighteningly plausible. An interesting feature is that it gives alternative paths for NATO and Russian success. Arguably a back story isn't required for a game like this, but I do think that it helps the player to feel involved and this one is a very good example.

notes.title: Combat Mission: Black Sea is coming to Steam
notes.content:
Last year we were treated to a new partnership between Matrix Games/Slitherine & Battlefront which brought Combat Mission: Shock Force 2 to steam. This isn't the only modern-era WEGO tactical wargame that the studio has made, however, and today the pair have announced that Combat Mission: Black Sea will also be coming to Steam in late January.

Black Sea, one of our favourite Combat Mission games, depicts a series of escalations between Russia and the Ukraine resulting in open conflict in the summer of 2017 (the game was first developed in 2009, but wasn't actually finalised until after the real invasion in 2014). It is a fictional scenario, and thus is not supposed to resemble the real life event, nor can it simulate the events that have unfolded since then. In the game's narrative, NATO also deploys its rapid deployment forces to aid Ukraine.

What it offers is a way to play around with highly detailed and researched American, Ukrainian and Russian forces at brigade level, from mechanised infantry to the 'Stryker' brigade which is an important piece of NATO's response forces. Whereas Shock Force 2 depicts evolving warfare in the middle-east between NATO and a local power, Black Sea attempts to simulate more matched 'peer-to-peer' warfare, using the full spectrum of forces and capabilities both sides are capable of bringing to the field.
